title: The census result schema leaves new_rows reuse free text, so a session writes 'cite and paraphrase' and apply refuses the whole part
goal: census_result.schema.json gives new_rows reuse the enum of kbcommon.REUSE's keys, so claude -p --json-schema keeps a session to a value apply accepts

run: import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon,census;s=json.load(open(census.RESULT_SCHEMA));e=s['properties']['new_rows']['items']['properties']['reuse'].get('enum');sys.exit(0 if e and set(e)==set(kbcommon.REUSE) else 1)

notes: Found in the 2026-10-21 census rerun: gitlab parts 3 and 17 were refused twice each at apply for reuse 'cite and paraphrase with attribution' / 'cite and paraphrase' (logs of the manager's phase-2 driver). Premise: the repro exits 1 on main.
